title: C: Function Pointers
description: Use function pointers to implement a simple calculator that can switch between different operations at runtime.

steps.title: Calculator with Function Pointers
steps.description: Define a function pointer type `typedef int (*op_fn)(int, int)`. Implement add, subtract, multiply, and divide functions. Write `int calculate(op_fn op, int a, int b)` that calls the function through the pointer. Test all four operations.

verification.failureMessage: Print results of all four operations
